sloka: चक्रवाक युता नित्यम् चित्र प्रस्थ वनान्तरा ।मातंग मृग यूथैः च शोभते सलिल अर्थिभिः ॥४-१-६५॥
transliteration: cakravāka yutā nityam citra prastha vanāntarā ।mātaṁga mṛga yūthaiḥ ca śobhate salila arthibhiḥ ॥4-1-65॥

translations.english: 'O Lakshmana look at the lotuses in clear water dashing against one another due to waves caused by the force of the wind.
